JSM TRAVEL

Useful Information Before Booking

Clear answers to common questions about requests, prices, availability and travel services.

How do I request a booking?

Send your name, destination, travel date, number of travelers and any useful preferences through the booking form or our contact channels. The request is reviewed before confirmation.

Is the displayed price always final?

Not necessarily. Availability and prices can change by date, room or service type, traveler details and supplier conditions. The final price is confirmed before booking.

Can I request a hotel that is not listed?

Yes. The hotel guide is a working reference, not a complete inventory. You can send the hotel name and your dates and we can review availability.

What information helps you prepare an offer?

Destination, travel date, nights, adults, children and ages, preferred meal plan, transfers, approximate budget and any special requirements.

Does visa assistance guarantee approval?

No. JSM TRAVEL can help with requirements and document preparation, but the decision belongs to the competent authority.

Can I request transfers only?

Yes, transfer requests can be submitted with the route, date, number of passengers and any relevant luggage or vehicle details.

Are Nile Cruise net rates published?

No. The website does not publish supplier net rates. For Nile Cruise options, request the current selling price and availability.

Can I pay online through the website?

The current website form does not process card payments. It is used to send a booking request and communicate with the JSM TRAVEL team.
